title: Platform Edge Common Definitions (BUILD-000)
description: Reusable edge/control definitions. FROZEN_BUILD_000_INVARIANT: MAX_SAFE_SEQUENCE=9007199254740991. Runtime ceiling enforcement is BUILD_002/BUILD_003. SPECIFIED != IMPLEMENTED != TESTED != CERTIFIED.
$comment: B000-D001/D002/D016/D017. Counter64 metric values are NOT sequences and MUST NOT use sequenceInteger.

MAX_SAFE_SEQUENCE.description: FROZEN_BUILD_000_INVARIANT JSON-safe sequence/control ceiling (2^53-1). Explicit runtime enforcement owned by BUILD-002/003.

AGENT_INGRESS_MAX_RECORDS.description: CURRENT_IMPLEMENTED_V1 Core AgentIngestionValidator.MAX_RECORDS (producer default may be smaller).

sequenceInteger.description: JSON-carried durable delivery/replay sequence. Zero prohibited on wire. No wrap. Ceiling is FROZEN_BUILD_000_INVARIANT; hop enforcement is BUILD_002/003.

controlCounterPositive.description: Control counters that must be >= 1 when present (e.g. assignment generation).

tenantId.description: Canonical tenant identity as UUID text on production authority paths.

siteId.description: Site identity as UUID text when present on production authority paths.

agentId.description: Bounded opaque case-sensitive Agent identifier (PostgreSQL VARCHAR(128)).

checksumSha256Hex.description: SHA-256 hex digest. Accepted wire: uppercase or lowercase (runtime EqualFold/isHex). Canonical producer emission: lowercase recommended.

sensorStreamId.description: Durable Sensor spool stream/generation identity carried as bootEpoch on v1 wire.

utcTimestamp.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC evidence timestamp with Z suffix (B000-D017).

agentDeliveryRecord.description: CURRENT_IMPLEMENTED_V1 Agent DeliveryRecord. Shared by Agent→Sensor batch and nested Sensor→Core agent-ingress delivery records. Sequences are strictly contiguous ascending (Sensor ValidateEnvelope).

payload.description: Non-empty JSON value. Receiver-compatible: Go json.RawMessage (any valid JSON). Producer-current shape: object collections. Do not falsely narrow the wire contract to object-only.
